canvas.$description: Canvas — Main page background, creating a warm, paper-like base.

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, headlines, and filled UI elements.

white.$description: White — Card surfaces, contrast text on dark backgrounds.

linen.$description: Linen — Secondary light backgrounds, subtle dividers.

cloud.$description: Cloud — Subtle container backgrounds, hover states.

stone.$description: Stone — Secondary body text, disabled states.

graphite.$description: Graphite — Sub-headings and secondary text with more emphasis.

mint.$description: Mint — Decorative background shapes, UI tags — a primary brand pastel.

marigold.$description: Marigold — Decorative background shapes, UI highlights — a warm primary brand pastel.

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Decorative background shapes, UI highlights — a cool primary brand pastel.

sky.$description: Sky — Hero background textures and atmospheric elements.

papaya.$description: Papaya — Accent frames on cards, callouts within illustrations.

azure.$description: Azure — Interactive icons and links within product mockups.

untitledseriffont.$description: Used exclusively for large, impactful headlines (H1/H2). Its literary feel provides a signature contrast to the functional sans-serif UI, making statements feel personal and crafted.

untitledsansfont.$description: The workhorse font for all UI elements, including buttons, navigation, body copy, and captions. Provides clarity and readability.
